rv.q: Vardalos, especially, made us believe that we’re getting to know a full human being who just happens to express herself through two-dimensional text.
Michael Griffo's warm, evocative language and the excellent acting in this two-hander make Pen Pals truly special.
What is not discussed is the volatile world these two lived in.

cn.t: This reader's theatre two-hander about decades of correspondence between American and British friends earns modest praise for tackling the challenge of finding compelling drama in everyday life, though its conventional Love Letters format feels familiar.
